headline: PPPM surges on a massive volume spike, posting a 42.9% gain over the past five days.
market_take: The market showed mixed activity across sectors. Agribusiness led the upside with PPPM’s 14.2σ volume spike and a 37.93% intraday rally, while the property sector lagged, highlighted by PF’s -20.00% drop and A’s -100.00% price gap. Consumer and construction stocks displayed volatility, notably SOLAR’s 17.8σ volume surge and APCS’s 16.78% opening gap followed by a 15.52% intraday decline. Several filings this week signal capital reductions and a rehabilitation petition, adding a layer of corporate‑action risk.
